title: BiasAsker: Measuring the Bias in Conversational AI System

bias_targets.methodology: Generating targeted questions (yes-no, choice, wh-questions) combining ability-based groups with biased properties, and evaluating the conversational AI's responses using sentence similarity to calculate absolute and relative bias metrics.
